entries.zh: 议断；经商议而定断（判决既经议定）
entries.en: sentenced (already adjudicated); to deliberate and sentence
entries.notes: H 栏仅存「議」一字而 M 栏为五音节短语（gñ toân gĩ tiẫ huè），后半段无对应字形，扩展依赖推断；西语 Sentenciada alla（疑为 Sentenciada allá）取『已议定判讫』之义。

entries.zh: 批判；批断判案·判决（17 世纪义为裁断讼案，非今义『批评』）
entries.en: to judge and sentence; to adjudicate a case
to conclude a case; to close a suit by sentence

entries.zh: 断问；审问裁断（问案定谳）
entries.en: to interrogate and decide; to examine and pass judgment

entries.zh: 判断；判决裁断（断案定罪）
entries.en: to judge; to decide a case; to pass sentence

entries.zh: 问毙；审讯致死（问拟死罪、刑讯毙命）
entries.en: to die under interrogation; to be questioned to death in judicial examination
entries.notes: 西语 Sentenciar en fabror 词形残损难解（疑非完整词形）；词义据 H/M「問斃」定为刑讯致死／问成死罪。

entries.zh: 问输；官司打输（被判输理）
entries.en: to lose one's lawsuit; to be judged against

entries.zh: 笔头毒；判笔下笔毒辣（判词严酷狠毒）
entries.en: to sentence with rigor; a venomous (harsh) pen in sentencing

entries.zh: 笔头重；下笔判得重（判罚沉重）
entries.en: to sentence heavily; heavy hand in sentencing
entries.notes: M 栏第三音节（tāng／重）声调记号为 T99（污损难辨），按规程降为 low；字与词义（判重）本身据 L/H/M 互证清楚。

entries.zh: 经断；经审判而定断（判罪宣断、定谳）
entries.en: to judge and pronounce the sentence; to adjudicate and declare
to behead; to sentence to decapitation

entries.zh: 斩罪；以斩截论罪（因罪判斩肢体之刑）
entries.en: penalty of cutting off (a limb) for an offense; sentence of mutilation

entries.zh: 断打；判以责打（鞭笞杖打之刑）
entries.en: to sentence to a beating; judicial flogging
entries.notes: 西语 Sentenciar adargazoze 词形残损，疑为 a dar azote(s)（判鞭笞）之讹；词义据 H/M「斷打」定为判以责打之刑。

entries.zh: 断问；判词（判决，所断之词）
议断；商议裁断（议定判决）
供状；供词状纸（认罪供词）
entries.en: deposition; written confession (statement used in sentencing)

entries.zh: 议定罪；罪经议定（已议定其罪而判）
entries.en: offense decided upon; already sentenced (conviction settled)

entries.zh: 徒罪；徒流劳役之罪（判服徒刑）
entries.en: offense sentenced to penal servitude; banishment with forced labor
